personal_info.name: Gwendolyn West
personal_info.family_details: Mother was a Sunday school teacher, only child

presenting_problem:
I tend to discount my achievements, particularly the awards I have won for ballet. This leads to feelings of inadequacy and devaluing my successes.
These feelings of discounting the positive have been present for a few years but have become more prominent recently.
I believe the stress of balancing nursing school and personal life may have intensified these feelings of discounting my achievements.
The problem has progressed to the point where I struggle to acknowledge my accomplishments and feel like they are insignificant.
I experience this pattern of discounting the positive in various situations, especially when receiving praise or recognition.
I have attempted to change this mindset on my own but have not been successful in fully appreciating my successes.
reason_seeking_counseling: I decided to seek counseling because I realized that discounting my achievements was impacting my self-worth and motivation.

more_information.past_history:
(including medical history)
I have not experienced similar problems before.
I have not received any treatment or counseling for psychological issues in the past.
I do not have any significant physical illnesses.
more_information.academic_occupational_functioning:
My performance in nursing school is satisfactory, but my mindset affects how I view my achievements.
Interpersonal relationships: My relationships with peers and mentors in nursing school have been affected by my tendency to discount my successes.
Daily life: My mindset has impacted my self-care routines and overall well-being.
more_information.social_support_system: I am close to my friends and can talk to them about various issues, but I have not discussed my feelings of discounting my achievements with them.

motivation_text: As a nursing student, my academic success is crucial for my future career and helping others, but discounting my achievements undermines my confidence and performance. Recognizing my ballet awards as proof of my dedication and ability can help me apply that same resilience to nursing school, boosting my self-worth and motivation to excel.
